description: Implementation of the GenericDataService interface, providing methods for executing SQL queries, retrieving table metadata, and converting database results into custom data structures within the Fineract project.

classes.name: GenericDataServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing data retrieval and processing logic for generic SQL result handling in Fineract.

methods.name: fillGenericResultSet
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and constructs a GenericResultsetData object containing column headers and data rows.

methods.name: fillResultsetColumnHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a given table and constructs detailed column header data, including code lookup handling.

methods.name: fillResultsetRowData
methods.description: Populates data rows from a SQL query result set based on provided column headers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs string replacement of all occurrences of a pattern with a specified string.

methods.name: wrapSQL
methods.description: Wraps SQL query to prevent certain JDBC errors and malicious input.

methods.name: generateJsonFromGenericResultsetData
methods.description: Converts a GenericResultsetData object into a JSON string suitable for transmission or display.

methods.name: isExplicitlyUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a table column has a unique index, considering naming conventions.

methods.name: isExplicitlyIndexed
methods.description: Checks whether a table column has an index.
